json.title: Mountains Turning Pink
json.logline: A family winter trip to Gangtok culminates in a breath-taking dawn as the snowy Himalayan peaks ignite in brilliant pink light.

palette: soft sage green in distant foliage
character_rules: one protagonist appears in every scene with the same face, hair length and build
wardrobe is identical from the first scene to the last
the face stays readable in at least three-quarter profile
style_bible.lighting: cinematic low-angle golden-hour light with gentle halation and soft falloff
style_bible.medium: loose gouache painting with visible brush strokes and softly blended colour

events.visual: Sparse felt piano note echoes over soft ambient pad
Gouache brushwork expands as shadows turn soft blue-violet
Four-on-the-floor kick drum enters as synth arpeggio doubles in speed
Explosion of radiant pink light washes across the snow peaks
Layered collage elements shimmer with offbeat handclaps
Drums cut out leaving a warm sustained chord
Final soft piano note decays over glowing distant peaks

scenes.camera_note: Slow gentle push inward focusing on expression
scenes.action: A young man turns his head toward a frost-dusted window.
scenes.setting: A dim quiet room in Gangtok with cold morning mist visible outside the window pane.

scenes.camera_note: Horizontal drift showing depth across mountain silhouettes
scenes.action: Mist glides across a dark alpine valley beneath towering jagged ridges.
scenes.setting: The vast cold valley of Gangtok under a deep blue-violet pre-dawn sky.

scenes.camera_note: Slow upward tilt from balcony railing to sky
scenes.action: A young man tilts his head up toward the horizon as cold mountain wind blows his hair.
scenes.setting: An open hotel balcony looking out onto the dark shadowy Himalayan range.

scenes.camera_note: Rapid tight push into frost crystals
scenes.action: Frost on a wooden balcony railing melts into clear shimmering water beads.
scenes.setting: Close-up view of the wooden railing overlooking the cold Gangtok horizon.

scenes.camera_note: Wide majestic pull back revealing the grand mountain panoramic scale
scenes.action: A young man gazes at the massive snow-capped mountain range turning vibrant pink.
scenes.setting: A high mountain balcony overlooking the towering snow peaks illuminated in warm pink morning light.

scenes.action: Golden sunlight washes across swirling morning mist on icy mountain slopes.
scenes.setting: Panoramic Himalayan landscape with glowing pink snow fields and sunlit valley clouds.

scenes.camera_note: Slow calming movement backwards as scene fades
scenes.action: A young man smiles softly toward the distant pink mountain peaks.
scenes.setting: A softly lit room doorway opening out onto the sunlit Himalayan sunrise.
